title: Origins: Doohickey
description: A Datapack that adds the Doohickey origin
body:
The Doohickey origin is an origin that has an array of advantages and disadvantages

# **Description**
An odd contraption made of a jumble of parts and machinery
# **Neutral**
## **Desaturated Skin**
Due to your robotic attributes, your body has turned a desatured grey colour
# **Advantages**
## **Strong Hands**
Due to your robotic hands, you can break blocks faster
## **Inner Storage**
You have a storage unit built into You
## **Drone**
You have wings built into you
# **Disadvantages**
## **Messy Construction**
Because you were poorly constructed, your maximum health is decreased by 3 full hearts
## **Hydrophobia**
Due to your robotic attributes, you rust of time in water, slowly killing you
## **Scorching Hot**
You Burn while in hot biomes
